snippet.title: Golden Tee Live (2006) - Test & Gameplay (TeknoParrot / RTX)
snippet.description:
*My Specs:*
- Windows 11 Pro 64-Bit | 24H2 | 32G RAM
- AMD Ryzen 3 3100 CPU (Stock) @ 3.60Ghz
- MSI GeForce RTX 3050 Gaming X (6G)
----------------
*Devices Used:*
- PC
- Mouse & Keyboard
----------------
*Programs Used:*
- OBS Studio (64bit)
- TeknoParrot 1.0.0. 1438 (Subscription)
- Nvidia Control Panel
- MSI Afterburner
- PostgreSQL 8.3
----------------
00:00 - Intro
01:42 - Attraction (Gameplay)
03:10 - How Many Golfers (1)
03:22 - Select Game (Golden Tee Sample)
04:26 - Golden Tee Sampler (Hole 1)
07:08 - Golden Tee Sampler (Hole 2)
09:26 - Golden Tee Sampler (Hole 3)
11:18 - Customize Golfer
----------------
*Issue's*
- Sound issues with Announcer
- Minor Graphical Glitches
----------------
*TeknoParrot UI Settings (Tested)*
- General - Input API = Raw-Input Trackball (Using Wired Mouse)
- Raw Input - Trackball X Sensitivity = 05 (Playable)
- Raw Input - Trackball Y Sensitivity = 05 (Playable)
----------------
